frontMatter.title: Meath Badminton: Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals – 22nd March
frontMatter.summary: This Sunday (22nd March), Meath competes in the Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals in Baldoyle and Tolka Rovers, with club members representing the county across every grade. Semi-finals start at 10am, finals at 2pm—best of luck to all teams. An Mhí Abú!
